name: GovernmentJobs.com
notes: General statewide GovernmentJobs.com board. Confirmed 2026-09-21: the keywords= param in this URL is not actually honored by the server-rendered result set (it returns general recent postings regardless), so this source relies entirely on the scraper's own keyword filter downstream -- it's normal for it to return 0 kept jobs on a run where nothing in the raw results happens to be IT-related.

name: Los Rios Community College District
notes: Los Rios CCD career site. The slug is 'losriosccd', not 'losrios' -- confirmed 2026-09-21 via search results for schooljobs.com/careers/losriosccd and governmentjobs.com/ProfileSettings/losriosccd. The old 'losrios' slug redirected to governmentjobs.com's bare homepage.

name: City of Elk Grove
notes: City of Elk Grove career microsite. A 2026-09-21 run only found 1 candidate link (Real-Time Information Center Operator) when at least 3 are actually open right now (also Police Support Specialist, Permit Processing Coordinator, per a search-engine check) -- likely a one-off slow-render timing issue since Los Rios/Sacramento found 86/101 candidates with the same code. Watch subsequent runs' sourceRunSummary candidate counts for this source; if it stays stuck near 1, the render wait time needs increasing further.

name: EDJOIN
notes: K-12 / education job board covering all CA school and county office of education postings. Confirmed 2026-09-21: unlike the NEOGOV sites, EDJOIN's list is capped by a `rows=` URL param (defaults to 10 with the bare /Home/Jobs URL, which is why a run only ever found 10 candidates total statewide) rather than being scroll-driven -- `rows=300` asks for far more per load. `days=0` disables any posting-date cutoff so it doesn't silently exclude older-but-still-open postings.
